data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 – refund of €767
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielhausen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024. Tax is set at €7,012.00, and after the €7,779.00 of wage tax already withheld, you get a refund of €767.00.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment for 2024. Because more wage tax was withheld than your tax due, you get €767.00 back. The office says it will pay this into your known bank account in the next few days. Check that the figures match your tax return. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or record it in person at the tax office. The app shows the deadline for this. If you accept it, no action is needed. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
